author: wasabi
sourceKind: publicly published interactive preview model JSON
licenseObligations: No attribution requirement; retain the supplied source credit as a courtesy.
changes: Cup prop; its straw uses native Java 1.21.11+ XYZ element rotation, supported by the target 26.3 runtime.
Adapted prop/pet: no upstream claim that it is a wearable Minecraft hat.
Use head slot anchor Y=1.85, ItemDisplay FIXED, 16 model units per block. Runtime head scale assumed 1.0.
Native item wrapper references minecraft:model. Parent owns final geometry/attachment visual QA, selection, and pack integration.
PNG bytes are unmodified. UV coordinates are normalized to Java 0..16 units using each texture UV dimensions, or the source project resolution for older .bbmodel files.
Texture references use noqui:item/cosmetics/<id>/texture_<n> so all custom sprites belong to the vanilla item atlas directory in 1.21.11+.

Only uniform geometry scaling/translation and the documented static pose/frame selection were applied. FIXED transforms are explicitly set for the head anchor; original held/head display transforms are replaced.
Source cullface hints were removed for detached display use; shade:false maps to 26.3 shade_direction_override:up.
